show.description: Beautiful and ambitious Tanya Verma is labeled a gold digger when she marries billionaire widower Kunal Malhotra a man twice her age. But as dark secrets, jealous rivals, and family conspiracies threaten to expose her, Tanya must prove she’s more than just a pretty face with a motive. In a world where love, money, and betrayal collide, who's really using whom?
